# `/common-access` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /common-access/v1

`getCommonAccessV1` — Get a paginated list of common access — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint returns the current common access for a customer. The returned items can be filtered and sorted. Requires authorization scope of iai:access-modeling:read

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage, iai:access-modeling:read
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: status: eq, sw; reviewedByUser: eq; access.id: eq, sw; access.type: eq; access.name: sw, eq; access.description: sw, eq — e.g. `access.type eq "ROLE"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: access.name, status By default the common access items are sorted by name, ascending. — e.g. `access.name`
- Returns 200: array of commonaccessresponse

### POST /common-access/v1

`createCommonAccessV1` — Create common access items — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API is used to add roles/access profiles to the list of common access for a customer. Requires authorization scope of iai:access-modeling:create

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- Body (application/json): commonaccessitemrequest
- Returns 202: commonaccessitemresponse

### POST /common-access/v1/update-status

`updateCommonAccessStatusInBulkV1` — Bulk update common access status — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This submits an update request to the common access application. At this time there are no parameters. Requires authorization scope of iai:access-modeling:update

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- Body (application/json): array of commonaccessidstatus
- Returns 202: object
